decisions.reason: The charting bundle has its own page, an announced launch and four quick releases, so the visible commitment and effort spent make continuation likely.
The hierarchical search bundle is a small plugin with only a mention on the website, so little is invested and dropping it would cost little, but it fits the map.apps ecosystem cheaply.
VueTOC was promoted on the home page as a new approach for mobile usability, a public commitment that management would want to justify rather than abandon after one year.

The software platform for building GIS solutions is central to the firm's announced direction of integrated enterprise geospatial solutions, so sunk investment and strategic fit strongly favor keeping it.
The mobile field data capture software has its own page and lies close to the core offer, so visible commitment and investment argue for persistence.
The search extension has a dedicated page and is close to the established offer, so it is a low-cost, publicly presented component that management will likely keep.
